decisions.reason: As a close extension of the established drainage range that remained more visible in 2024, it fits the firm's existing knowledge base and can be supported and refined efficiently through its own R&D and channel expertise.

This shower channel is tightly aligned with the firm's core drainage and design competences, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests management sees enough market traction and learning potential to retain it.

Although it builds on the firm's shower drainage know-how and can benefit from internal development capabilities, the pump-assisted subcategory appears less certain because a related earlier pump solution disappeared, so it is kept but with a materially higher review risk.
